execute.docs: This action executes the script. The script **mode** dictates what will happen if the script was already running.

stop.docs: This action allows you to stop a given script during execution. If the script is not running, it does nothing. This is useful if you want to stop a script that contains a `delay` action, `wait_until` action, or is inside a `while` loop, etc. You can also call this action from the script itself, and any subsequent action will not be executed.

wait.docs: This action suspends execution of the automation until a script has finished executing.

is_running.docs: This [condition](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-conditions) allows you to check if a given script is running. In case scripts are run in `parallel`, this condition only tells you if at least one script of the given id is running, not how many. Not designed for use with [while](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#while-action); instead try [script.wait](https://esphome.io/components/script#script-wait-action).

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The [ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id) of the script. Use this to interact with the script using the script actions.

*See also: [Script Component](https://esphome.io/components/script#configuration-variables)*

max_runs.docs:
**int**: Allows limiting the maximum number of script instances.

*See also: [Script Component](https://esphome.io/components/script#configuration-variables)*

mode.docs:
**string**: Controls what happens when a script is invoked while it is still running from one or more previous invocations. Default to `single`.

*See also: [Script Component](https://esphome.io/components/script#configuration-variables)*

parameters.docs:
**[Script Parameters](https://esphome.io/components/script#script-parameters)**: A script can define one or more parameters that must be provided in order to execute. All parameters defined here are mandatory and must be given when calling the script.

*See also: [Script Component](https://esphome.io/components/script#configuration-variables)*
